description: Representation-native shape transport for Gaussian parameterizations backed by stable triangle soup. The object must undergo substantial motion while triangle edge lengths and areas remain finite and stable.

provenance.reference_formula: relative edge error = |l_t/l_0 - 1|; relative area error = |A_t/A_0 - 1|
regime_assumptions: nonzero initial edge lengths and areas
provenance.notes: The motion gate prevents a static triangle soup from passing. The released GASP TeddyBear Taichi trajectory is the frozen first external submission.
